metadata.body:
<!--

a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Aligns HTTP library APIs before stabilization in #20828.

```java
AttributesExtractor<NettyRequest, HttpResponse> extractor =
    AttributesExtractor.constant(AttributeKey.stringKey("custom"), "value");

NettyServerTelemetry.builder(openTelemetry)
    .addAttributesExtractor(extractor)
    .build();
```

All 19 HTTP builders use invariant extractor types. Java HTTP Client callers using broader types must switch to `AttributesExtractor<HttpRequest, HttpResponse<?>>`.

`NettyRequest` becomes final with no public constructor; its request, channel, and nullable remote-address getters remain available.

The Servlet library keeps its internal javax helper as a runtime dependency without exposing it on consumers' compile classpaths. The javaagent declares its own direct dependency.

Ratpack retains `throws Exception` because its supported `HttpClient.copyWith` API requires it.
